items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1963-03-29
items.q: when Guy Kelly came here, I used to like to hear Guy play too because he could blow.

ctx.x: Nelson and Eddie Summers. I mean them your favorite fellas. Yeah. In the old days. In the old days. What favorite music that I liked the best? Well in the street my favorite trumpet player was Manuel Perez and Red Allen in the street. That's my favorite trumpet player. Manuel Perez, Red Allen, Willie Pazio and so he's living in Nightward, Maurice Duran. And then later on when Guy Kelly came here, I used to like to hear Guy play too because he could blow. items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: We used to play with Guy at the Willow Inn.

ctx.x: Well, he used to have banjos. Banjos. Banjos. Banjos, yeah.

You know, Georgie Boy could talk to you in the clarinet, you know? He'd talk to his hands and his clarinet. Really? Yeah. He used to like it in his voice? We used to play with Guy at the Willow Inn. I remember he used to send John Kazmin nights that he had to work, you know, somewhere. Yeah.
Who were some of the best banjo players when you were just coming up, when you were starting to learn? Or who did you like to hear?
